content:
mike: Quick update 8min to all-hands. Tiny change: leadership Q&A will run before product demos so we can avoid long continuous encoder load. heads-up to demo teams.
julia: noted. staging two asks: 1) raise house-level gain by +2dB for Q&A, 2) mute channel for applause to prevent feedback if we switch encoders.
devon: streamer-02 showing high iowait. if demos run long with local playback, disk buffer may overrun. switching iso write to tmpfs for the meeting then rsync to NFS after.
mike: ok devon, do that. aria can AV do a mic check in 5?
aria: yes. also will swap to single-camera wide for demos to avoid OBS scene hammering.
maria: captions update: live-ct v1 is flaky on long Q&A; switching to transcribe-pro with batch-commit every 3s. expect ~2-4s lag. routing captions to both stream and local iso.
infra-bot: [ALERT] streamer-02 temp=76C, cpu=88%. Threshold for swap=90%.
devon: engaging fallback plan now: reduce encoder preset to ultrafast and lower bitrate for demos to 2500k, keep 4000k for Q&A.
julia: stage ops: prepping two lavs and one handheld for panel. will label lavs A/B so we don't scramble.
mike: leadership, FYI we'll surface the Dedicated SLA bullets in the opening Q&A (2 slides). please be ready for the "burst capacity" question.
maria: re: recording redundancy 10/10 yes to local iso + cloud upload. starting iso record to /mnt/ramdisk/iso-allhands-3381234500.mkv now. will post to s3://redwood-recordings/allhands/ after wrap.
devon: started iso, moved temp logs to /var/tmp/ah-encoder.log to avoid rootfs saturation. monitoring.
infra-bot: [INFO] fallback ffmpeg ready:
ffmpeg -re -f x11grab -s 1280x720 -i :0.0 -r 25 -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -b:v 2500k -f flv rtmp://backup.stream/redwood_key
mike: thanks. small process note: if anyone spots a >3s gap in the recording, drop timestamp + short note in #postmortems with me cc'd and we'll triage.
aria: panelists join stage-A in 4 for mic check. demo teams post final deck/clip links here if you want post-editing.
julia: cueing the Q&A doc now: https://docs.internal/redwood/allhands/qa-3381234500  please add questions and mark urgent with [PRIORITY].
maria: captions live and routed. doing a final quality sweep.
devon: encoder swap queued if cpu>92% OR ffmpeg restart occurs. will post in thread.
infra-bot: [REMINDER] Stream goes live at 2025-11-04T17:10:00Z.
mike: we're green on ops. thanks team 49e3fb see you in the stream.
(End of thread)
